scope: Fixed-image verl source and dispatch audit only; original copied files retained in local research cache.
method: Unchanged dispatcher AST with synthetic shape-only sentinel objects and recording leaf functions; no numeric kernels executed.
findings: Dispatcher prioritizes flash-attn availability, then torch_npu operator availability; no per-tensor device check.
NPU wrapper flattens logits and labels, calls npu_cross_entropy_loss(reduction=none), returns negative loss reshaped to original batch dimensions.
NPU wrapper performs no explicit FP32 cast; actual autocast/operator accumulation and returned dtype require runtime observation.
Pinned padded actor slices response positions after full model logits and calls dispatcher inside device autocast.
Prior ASR CE diagnostic compares model loss with project response_log_probs; it does not directly invoke the verl NPU dispatcher.
limits: Static source and dispatch control flow only. No new NPU process, numerical equivalence, gradient, throughput or Omni accuracy claim.
